description: Exact, temporary baseline of OSV findings that are strictly below the canonical blocking threshold (--audit-level=high), strictly dev-only, absent from the production standalone artifact, with no published fix. Any finding not listed here, any HIGH/CRITICAL, any production-reachable finding, any published fix, any lockfile change, or an expired entry FAILS the gate (scripts/security/osv-threshold-gate.mjs). No wildcards, no advisory families.

findings.noFixRationale: Advisory last_affected is 1.1.3, which is the latest published sprintf-js version — no fixed release exists. The parent cannot be lifted off it without breaking Jest coverage tooling: argparse@1.0.10 pins sprintf-js ~1.0.2, and js-yaml@3.15.2 (required by @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config@1.1.0) cannot be forced to js-yaml@4 without breaking load-nyc-config.
findings.artifactAbsenceProof: Re-verified on the standalone build of the candidate pinned to this lockfile (next 15.5.27): 0 node_modules/sprintf-js directories under .next/standalone, 0 code references to sprintf-js in the bundled server, 0 sprintf-js components in the runtime CycloneDX SBOM (security/sbom/runtime.cdx.json).
findings.reachabilityRationale: sprintf-js is loaded only by argparse's help/usage text formatting, which runs inside Jest's coverage tooling at test time. It is never imported by the application, never present in the .next/standalone artifact, and never receives a user-controlled format string (argparse formats its own internal templates).
compensatingControls: Absent from the production standalone artifact (verified by the OSV gate's artifact scan).
No user-controlled format string reaches sprintf-js.
Pinned by exact lockfile digest; any dependency or version change invalidates this baseline.
Expires 2026-10-21; must be re-triaged or removed by then.
